decisions.reason: As a small accessory with limited strategic importance, it would be easier to discontinue if its results have not clearly met aspiration levels and the resources are more useful in core trailer lines.
Its home-page prominence and strong fit with the firm's core box-trailer business suggest performance at or near aspiration levels, so boundedly rational management would continue it.
As a more specialized niche trailer with less visible prominence, it is more likely to fall short of aspirations and trigger problemistic search toward better uses of capacity.
The low-bed trailer series matches the firm's established capabilities and customer base well, so with acceptable results and some organizational slack it would likely be retained.
This complementary cover series supports the broader trailer offering and can be kept if performance is mixed but not clearly below aspiration levels.
Despite some possible overlap with another box trailer series, its home-page visibility and close relation to the core business make continued marketing more likely than withdrawal.
